_note: Fixed customer sentences for the lawn report rain card (GATE_LAWN_WATER_RAIN), owner-approved 2026-10-09 (advisor sections A.3 R3/R5 and A.4). {wiltSigns} is filled from shared/watering-copy.json; {target} is the card's own target label, formatted by the caller exactly as the card formats it today. covered: Rain alone covered your lawn this week. Leave the sprinklers off until the grass shows {wiltSigns}, then run one full cycle on an allowed watering day.
surplus: Rain and your sprinklers together put down more than your lawn can use this week. Skip a watering day rather than shortening your runs — longer runs reach the roots better than short ones.
sensorLine: Florida law requires a rain shutoff device on an automatic sprinkler system. If yours skipped a run this week, it is working.
deficitAction: If the grass shows {wiltSigns}, run one full cycle on your next allowed watering day.
